message.comment: Match ends, Arsenal 2, Liverpool 2.
Second Half ends, Arsenal 2, Liverpool 2.
Goal! Arsenal 2, Liverpool 2. Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom left corner.
Penalty Liverpool. Cody Gakpo draws a foul in the penalty area.
Penalty conceded by William Saliba (Arsenal) after a foul in the penalty area.
Declan Rice (Arsenal) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Arsenal. Kai Havertz replaces Gabriel Jesus.
Attempt saved. Luis Diaz (Liverpool) left footed shot from the centre of the box is saved in the top centre of the goal.
Goal! Arsenal 2, Liverpool 1. Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) right footed shot from the centre of the box. Assisted by Bukayo Saka.
Corner, Arsenal. Conceded by Virgil van Dijk.
Second Half begins Arsenal 1, Liverpool 1.
First Half ends, Arsenal 1, Liverpool 1.
Goal! Arsenal 1, Liverpool 1. Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Trent Alexander-Arnold.
Attempt missed. Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) header from the centre of the box misses to the left.
Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) is shown the yellow card.
Corner, Liverpool. Conceded by Ben White.
Attempt blocked. Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) left footed shot from the left side of the box is blocked.
Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) hits the right post with a curling right footed shot from the right side of the box.
Goal! Arsenal 1, Liverpool 0. Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Martin Odegaard.
Corner, Arsenal. Conceded by Ibrahima Konate.
First Half begins.
Lineups are announced and players are warming up.
